title: MAIDS Notification 2026 - Apply for Various Consultant Posts
description: The Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS) has officially released the notification to fill up the vacancies for Consultant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in BDS or MDS can grab this chance and apply for the MAIDS Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
